'''Gunnery officers''' were combat positions within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]]. Gunnery officers were part of the staff assigned to [[IM-455 modular garrison]]s.<ref name="SWS" />
